messages:
maria: starting quick bake on GPTQ variants across Llama/Mistral/Qwen. hitting a few accuracy anomalies vs FP8 baseline, opening thread for triage
eli: which evals and benchmarks?
maria: SQuAD v2 EM, TruthfulQA (hard subset), long-context summarization 8k, WikiText ppl, and short instruction-sensitivity probes. comparing FP8/FP16 -> gptq-4, awq-8, int8
tyler: saw similar in my local spotcheck — kv-cache + compiled-attn seems to misalign for certain seq lengths, causes token shifts on beam decode
maria: reproducible commands below
maria: ```bash
python -m redwood_evals.run --model qwen-30b --quant gptq-4 --seq_len 8192 --batch 1 --decode beam --deterministic
python -m redwood_evals.run --model mistral-7b --quant awq-8 --seq_len 4096 --batch 4 --decode greedy
python -m redwood_evals.run --model llama-2-13b --quant int8 --task squad_v2 --batch 8
```
maria: overnight deltas (vs nightly FP8):
- mistral-7b-gptq4: SQuAD EM down 1.6
- qwen-30b-gptq4: TruthfulQA hard set down 3.2
- llama-2-13b-awq8: WikiText ppl +0.7
- qwen-30b-awq8: 8k summarization ROUGE-L -2.1
eli: that TruthfulQA hit is notable. any sign tokenization drift or EOSs earlier?
maria: token diffs show occasional token collapse around punctuation and multi-token named entities; more frequent early EOS in top beam for some configs
tyler: repro'd kv misalign when compiled attention + continuous batching enabled and seq>2048. workaround: disable kv cache or continuous batching during canary
lina: artifacts are in s3://redwood-evals/gptq-bakes/2812345678/{qwen,mistral,llama}/
maria: runtime traced an attention-reorder path that only fires when seq_len>2048 and kv_cache=true for some Mistral kernels. gating reorder by seq_len might help
sam: starting deterministic repro for qwen-30b-gptq4 with seq=512, beam=4 to see if issue is long-context dependent
maria: found a concrete token example in nightly diffs: expected "June 12, 1999" got "June 1999" — date token collapse under beam
eli: could be quantized embeddings/table rounding. i'm going to diff embedding vectors and token logits
maria: infra note: qwen-30b-gptq4 OOM'd on 24GB GPUs in nightly, CI logged it
eval-bot: nightly-eval: qwen-30b-gptq4 failed OOM on 24GB, CI: https://ci.redwood/evals/2812345678
maria: oof, for 8k runs we may need 80GB or sharded execution or lower batch size
tyler: i'll prepare a kernel patch to add a guard that disables reorder for high seq_len and attach a unit test that reproduces the misalign
eli: suggested rollout policy: canary GPTQ into a small dedicated pool (5% traffic) with auto-fallback to FP8 if daily eval drift > thresholds
maria: propose hard thresholds: SQuAD EM drop >=2.0 OR TruthfulQA drop >=2.5 OR longctx ROUGE-L drop >=2.0
lina: added nightly DAG: kv-check -> deterministic seq-512 -> seq-4096 longctx -> deploy-readiness. will push CI links into the artifacts
sam: repro in progress, ETA 30m. posting logs when ready
eli: i'll run per-token logprob diffs and produce top-10 offending prompts for Slack alerts
maria: AWQ-8 looks promising for Llama family (closer to FP8) while GPTQ-4 wins size but has more tail regressions on factual prompts
tyler: short term: add a CI smoke that exercises compiled-attn + continuous batching on small seqs to catch this earlier
lina: Ops: please create 5% dedicated canary pool with rollback to FP8 and alerting to eng-ml
maria: open action items:
1) tyler -> kernel guard PR + unit reproducer (#4567)
2) sam -> finish deterministic repro & gist logs
3) eli -> embedding mean diffs + TruthfulQA focused shard
4) ops -> 5% canary pool + auto-fallback
sam: posted gist: https://s3.redwood/gists/2812345678/qwen-gptq-token-diffs.txt
maria: thanks all, update here when repro/PR land. :thumbsup:
